displayName: Mplacas - falha em Cloud Run Job operacional

documentation.content: Um Cloud Run Job obrigatório terminou sem sucesso. Identifique `resource.labels.job_name`, inspecione a execução e siga `docs/runbook-producao.md`.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.location="${GCP_REGION}" AND resource.labels.job_name=monitoring.regex.full_match("${GCP_OPERATIONAL_JOB_PREFIX}-(collect|daily-pipeline|dispatch-outbox|drain-collection|drain-report-exports|daily-digest|retention|operational-watchdog|cost-audit)") AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result!="succeeded"
